variants.headline: People leave the colony on the ship
variants.sub: The ship has taken away young adults with no work and families with no home.
variants.body:
The ship in port has taken {left} people away from the colony: young adults with no work and families with no home. For {target}, the departure raises a direct question about the conditions of belonging, rather than a simple argument over whether a smaller population is a good or bad headline.

A ship can carry people away as well as bring them here. Young adults with no work. Families with no home. Those plain circumstances deserve more attention than a fine speech about staying. Readers should ask what belonging requires before blaming someone for deciding to leave the colony.

The stewardship of {target} warrants scrutiny through the stated lack of work and homes. This paper records departure without assuming the destinations, hopes or future decisions of the people who have left. Readers deserve a clear story and a straight answer about responsibility.
